notes.title: Our Next Game Just Dropped!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]After Katie's harrowing Halloween in Easthollow, take a cozy break for Love's Crescendo.[/b][/h3]

[h2]📣Today is the launch day for Love's Crescendo 📣[/h2]
We're pleased to present our latest game, Love's Crescendo, a cozy rhythm game visual novel about finding true love and reigniting that spark for your passions. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/be55528878e2c511409736b85a248ffc6f85b303.png[/img]

[h2]🎹 Play Rhythm Games with an Original Soundtrack 🎹[/h2]
Love's Crescendo features 10 magnificent, original songs by our composers. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/3e2c9090cf7d55a04cb3b7003afcb0848f1e5128.png[/img]

[h2]💿 Jukebox 💿[/h2]
Love's Crescendo has replay value! Play the rhythm games outside of the story via the jukebox for an unlimited amount of fun~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/5ab019625b4f4731ee3059c394305acdeb713f07.jpg[/img]

[h2]💕31,000+ words of wholesome sapphic romance 💕 [/h2]
Our story features two lovely ladies as they fall in love, both with their music and with each other. <3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/471799cadf662708a9d2cef60e39fce4b2d9cb08.png[/img]

[h2]🎨8 Vibrant CGs🎨[/h2]
We have 8 CGs that perfectly capture the moments in the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/3fa213eab2eef3cb2e2c66ee28de8e8bd7ac2550.png[/img]

[h2]☕ A cozy gaming experience ☕[/h2]
Overall, we wanted Love's Crescendo to be a cozy gaming experience where players can enjoy a non-competitive rhythm game alongside a heartwarming story. If you're looking for a rhythm game that's low-stress, this one is perfect for you. It's okay if you don't get perfect scores, it won't affect the outcome of the story!

notes.title: Slippery Flippers: Episode one - Amulet of the Gods Out!
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's been a while since our last release, and we're excited to announce[i] Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods[/i] has been released!

[i]Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods[/i] started as a game jam, and we enjoyed making it so much we've made updates from the game jam version, and have released it here on Steam!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41161073/9d5f1a4091ac8b5f520bc851ac1849cb90f0f2bd.png[/img]

[h1][b]What is it about?[/b][/h1]

[i]Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods[/i] is the first in an episodic visual novel series that follows Orlando and his crew (Veda, Walter, and Chip) of outlaws. They're taking on their biggest heist yet: stealing the Amulet of the Gods from a museum, and it's said to have god-like power. While that may be true, their more in it for the fortune they can get by selling the amulet.

Will they be able to succeed in their heist with Riggs and Luca, the local law enforcement, hot on their tails?

Find out by playing our newest gem!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2265650/Slippery_Flippers_Episode_One__Amulet_of_the_Gods/

You might also notice some paintings in the museum, based on our other games!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41161073/74c1843cf49f98c22977b5cde05458b9f0c30eeb.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog Patch Update for Not It: Spookiest Edition
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We've made a small patch to [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i] as we come up on the first year anniversary! These patches are to fix some issues we found.

A few things we've fixed:
-Fixed a bug with incorrect sprites display
-Fixed a bug with incorrect name displayed typos
-Fixed a bug when clicking to progress wasn't working
-Removed the animated logo that is displayed after every ending (the logo will only show once when the game starts)
-Removed the gore setting that displayed after every ending (you can find it in the settings menu)

If you run into any problems with the patch or come across any additional bugs, let us know!

Thank you!

notes.title: The Last Act Anniversary Sale
notes.notes:
Hello~

We're so excited to share that we're doing a 50% off sale for [i]The Last Act[/i]!

[i]Why?[/i]

Because on March 16th, 2021 we released [i]The Last Act[/i] meaning it's been [b]ONE WHOLE YEAR[/b]!

This is a big milestone, and we always enjoy celebrating these special anniversaries for our games.

So, grab your copy of [i]The Last Act[/i] for 50% off if you don't already have it!

You'll get to go on a journey with our protagonist Sarah as she lands her lead role in a play only to find out the theater is haunted!! Will she have to give up her dream? Or... could she find love along the way? After all, her co-star Joshua is always around... and that detective named Gavin... OH and a ghost named Silas! So many options!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1412180/The_Last_Act/

notes.title: Not It: Spookiest Edition Release & Bookmarks
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's been a little over a week since we released [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i] on October 12th! We've been so excited about the game's reception, and that we finally got to share the game with everyone.

To celebrate the release, we're continuing our tradition of making special DIY bookmarks for the characters. We've provided instructions for printing along with the bookmark assets [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1uP6YcHMZ_U1pdQZ4AtvXUVl0AXA_EXN7]here[/url]. Let us know what you think of the finished product!

If you haven't already, make sure you grab your copy of [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i] for a ~spoooky~ Halloween!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719770/Not_It_Spookiest_Edition/

Thank you as always for your continued support throughout [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i]! Make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SnowhavenStudio]Twitter[/url] to get our frequent updates on future visual novels, and when our games will be on sale!

notes.title: Not It: Spookiest Edition Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone~

We've put out a small patch to [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i]! Learn about what we've fixed/updated:

[list]
[*]Joseph will be more active during one of the action sequences.
[*]Joseph won't exist in two places at once after hiding in the closet (otherwise known as "Ghost Joseph.")
[*]There was one line where the cast was unexpectedly silent but that is no longer the case.
[*]Katie's new haircut is now on display in one of the ending artworks (it will remain unlocked if you unlocked it previously).
[*]Some players using newer Mac computers (M1/Apple Silicone) were having issues launching the game. This has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Not It: Spookiest Edition NOW OUT!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/396963d2a623a0e616f71fb2253d54a88b4f8e0b.png[/img]Hello everyone~

We've finally done it, [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i] is now out!

Our team has been working extra hard to ensure that [i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i] is our most polished visual novel to date. 

Featuring full English voice acting, tons of CGs to collect, and different endings to explore it's your time to embark on a journey with Katie to her new home in Easthollow. Decide the fate of Easthollow's residents and make meaningful choices around the mysterious centuries-old curse. Is it real? Is it fiction? Only you can decide.

Want to play a spooky ~Halloween~ game without the gore? Take advantage of our new toggle less-gore feature that provides an alternate censored version of our violent CGs!

Thank you all for your support and excitement for this release.

Consider leaving us a Steam review to let us know what you thought!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/7c360c58cfb3135c2bd5616defc718c569bfdcd7.gif[/img]
[i]Note: this is just a fun gif we made to show  Katie struggling with her meaningful choices.[/i]

notes.title: Meet the Residents of Easthollow
notes.notes:
[i]Not It: Spookiest Edition[/i] is a gory horror visual novel that takes place right on Halloween in the New England town of Easthollow! 

Learn more about each of the eight residents here, and what part they may play in Katie's living nightmare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/5f866bab83aa07a2c78a043dd001e624c1782a2a.png[/img]

[i]Katie - The Protagonist. Easthollow's newest resident. Does she believe? Voice Actor: [url=https://breannamacdowall.com/]Breanna MacDowall[/url]. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/1dc4cbf190655d758d5b3670714ac29b471f5f98.png[/img]

[i]Mayor - The Public Servant. Confident. Prideful to a fault. Voice Actor: [url=https://www.antfishvo.com/]Anthony Sardinha[/url][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/319b881c3e0191d1e030871ef7a3842de27bd2ba.png[/img]

[i]Willow - The Skeptic. Historian. Believes in fact not fiction. Voice Actor: [url=https://arianarosario.crd.co/]Ariana Rosario[/url][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/4450762d47dbace43430e761b17abfdb7a6eeb5e.png[/img]

[i]Joseph - The Coward. Believes in the curse. Easthollow resident. Voice Actor: [url=https://twitter.com/JonFloresVO]Jonathan Flores[/url][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/9546cb008cabbf8f6eee575f0d1f8e4b56a2b99c.png[/img]

[i]Rita - The Believer. Spiritual. Faithful in more ways than one. Voice Actor: [url=https://www.hannahhellwig.com/]Hannah Hellwig[/url][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/ed8bbeb9e80c385570f1a0c0701522818aa8e8fb.png[/img]

[i]Officer Mike - The Law. Protector of Easthollow. Self-proclaimed leader. Voice Actor: [url=http://www.hulahulamoocow.com/]Duffy Weber[/url][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/692c870ec4719a164f1c64c74d8a34454efacd97.png[/img]

[i]Frank - The Steward. Believes in the curse. Old fashioned. Voice Actor: [url=https://www.vegasvoiceactor.com/]Timothy Callaway[/url][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41161073/6b2e4974309875aa7dce5d637cbdd254d7e686de.png[/img]

[i]Vinnie - The Outsider. Stranger. Suspicious of the curse. Voice Actor: [url=https://www.ryannegron.com/]Ryan Negrón[/url][/i]
